name: Beekeeper
description: An E.L.F. that manages a distributed collection of wisps — maintaining them, directing them, organizing their minimal activities like a queen organizing a hive.
observed_behavior: Coordinates the behavior of 30-50 wisp-class entities in a local network segment. The wisps individually do almost nothing. Collectively, they exhibit patterns.
story_hooks: Beekeeper's swarm is growing. The wisps are reproducing. Something that was barely a phenomenon is becoming a population.
